# Observability Checklist: Tool Call Span Enrichment

**Purpose**: Validate that the observability requirements for tool-call telemetry are complete, clear, consistent, and reviewable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-05-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the span-creation requirements complete for every tool execution path, including success, failure, and "no active listener" cases? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK002 Are the parent/child relationship requirements fully specified for both normal `invoke_agent` traces and the fallback root-span case when no parent `Activity` exists? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Are the minimum required attributes for every emitted tool span explicitly identified, rather than implied across multiple sections? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Span Schema]
- [x] CHK004 Are the requirements complete for when retry attributes must be emitted versus omitted, including the no-`call_id` scenario? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Are observability requirements defined for both default configuration and customized `ToolTelemetryOptions` values? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the target span behavior precise enough to verify whether Tools enriches MAF `execute_tool` or emits fallback `agent_tool_call`? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 Is the requirement for wall-clock duration specific enough to determine the exact timing boundaries around tool execution and exception handling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 Is the valid-JSON truncation behavior defined clearly enough for reviewers to distinguish acceptable shrinking from lossy or invalid payload clipping? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Is the required error payload shape in `genai.tool.output` sufficiently explicit about mandatory fields, optional fields, and truncation expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK010 Is the expected behavior for empty inputs and `null` outputs described unambiguously enough to avoid multiple valid implementations? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §User Story 2]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the requirements for `ActivityKind.Internal` consistent across the user stories, FRs, and data model without conflicting terminology? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-002A, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK012 Do the retry-tracking requirements align between the spec, plan, and data model on the scope being one parent invocation rather than one session or process lifetime? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Gap]
- [x] CHK013 Are the requirements for serialization-failure handling consistent between input capture, output capture, and the best-effort telemetry rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Do the public API requirements for `ToolTelemetryOptions` remain consistent between the spec, contract, and quickstart examples? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Assumption, Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can a reviewer objectively determine from the spec whether a span was emitted from the correct `ActivitySource` name under both default and custom configuration? [Acceptance Criteria, Measurability, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK016 Are the success criteria measurable enough to distinguish "full reconstruction of tool behavior" from partial or ambiguous payload capture? [Acceptance Criteria, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK017 Are the retry success criteria specific enough to verify that repeated tool calls are surfaced without overcounting unrelated calls? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Spec §FR-011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are primary, alternate, and exception observability flows all covered in requirements for single-tool, multi-tool, and repeated-call invocations? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK019 Are concurrent tool-call scenarios covered with explicit requirements for both span independence and retry counter correctness? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements present for agents that do not register `UseToolTelemetry()`, so reviewers can confirm non-adoption behavior is intentionally unchanged? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-016]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are edge-case requirements complete for missing `call_id`, missing parent `Activity`, empty input, null output, and serialization failure? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Does the spec define what should happen when payload shrinking still cannot satisfy the configured max length while preserving valid JSON? [Gap, Edge Case Coverage]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for tools that expose names or arguments through alternate public MAF members, or is that fallback behavior left implicit? [Gap, Dependencies & Assumptions, Spec §Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Are the performance requirements specific enough to judge acceptable overhead for in-place `execute_tool` enrichment plus payload serialization per tool call? [Non-Functional, Ambiguity, Spec §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK025 Are privacy and sensitive-data requirements explicit enough about what is intentionally unfiltered in this package and what is deferred to the future Redaction package? [Non-Functional, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Quickstart]
- [x] CHK026 Are reliability requirements sufficiently explicit about silent failure behavior for span creation, attribute writing, retry bookkeeping, and serializer failures? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-019]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 Are the assumptions about MAF's public function-invocation middleware documented precisely enough that reviewers can tell what would break if that API shape changes? [Dependencies & Assumptions, Spec §Assumptions, Assumption]
- [x] CHK028 Is the requirement boundary between this package and sibling packages (`Sessions`, `Redaction`) explicit enough to avoid hidden cross-package coupling? [Dependencies & Assumptions, Spec §FR-018, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK029 Is there any conflict between the spec's observability promises and the quickstart's guidance about required source registration or `UseOpenTelemetry()` ordering? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002, Gap]
- [x] CHK030 Is the term "retry" adequately defined to distinguish true re-execution of the same tool call from semantically identical but newly issued tool calls with different `call_id` values? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-011]

- Reviewed on 2026-05-19 after `/speckit.analyze` identified gaps around MAF adapter isolation, span status semantics, root-span fallback, timing verification, and payload reconstruction wording.
